newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Hermis busy as Lithuanian shares gain.
newsitem.headline: Hermis busy as Lithuanian shares gain.

text.p: Lithuanian shares maintained their recent rise on Friday, with Hermis Bank and the Birzai Milk company actively traded.
Overall central market volume was 885,839 litas while the group A index rose by 14.60 points to 1501.68. The group A index tracks the central market's 33 most active listings.
Hermis Bank, one of the largest commercial banks, saw its shares rise to 150 litas from 145 on turnover of 503,550 litas.
Birzai Milk dairy company continued to be active after a successful issue of global depository receipts (GDR) and rose to 9 litas from 7.84 on turnover of 178,848 litas.
Bloc trades worth 577,893 litas were also made on Friday and Hermis Bank registered business of 419,204 litas at a range of 148 to 147 litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill 30,202 litas.
